integrity: Proof derives all-n character from graph connectivity, Ko-Park first-homology theorem, a natural equivariant surjection, and signed cubical Euler-Poincare; exact small-instance checks use an embedded standalone verifier.
scientific_limitations: Rational character for two unordered particles on KG(n,2), n>=6; integral torsion-freeness only for H2; no higher-particle, cohomology-ring, or integral module-splitting claims.
title: The complete symmetric-group character of two-point Kneser graph configuration homology
